data.title: Mesa Expands NPU Capabilities With Support For YOLOX With PyTorch
data.description: While Mesa is predominantly used for GPU drivers, open-source developer Tomeu Vizoso continues advancing the capabilities of NPUs within the Mesa driver stack.
